_extraction_flags.notes: Architectural/Concept paper. Discusses ISAC in TN-NTN (Terrestrial & Non-Terrestrial) networks. Mentions FSO/Optical channels as one of the physical layers, but focus is on Management & Orchestration (O-RAN, 3GPP).

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Generic OFDM ISAC resource grid. Fig 2: TN-NTN 3D Network Architecture (Satellites, Drones, Ground). Fig 3: O-RAN Management Architecture (RIC, SMO).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: Focus is on high-level network architecture (TN-NTN) and how to manage ISAC data using O-RAN/3GPP frameworks (RIC, NWDAF).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: No specific experimental results or performance benchmarks (BER, CRB, etc.).
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Valuable for the 'Network Levels' or 'Challenges' section of the survey, specifically regarding the integration of FSO-based NTN nodes into a larger 6G ISAC manageent plane.

bibliographic.authors: Francesco Matera, Marina Settembre, Ernestina Cianca, Marina Ruggieri, Arcangela Rago, Alessio Fascista, Giuseppe Piro, Luigi Alfredo Grieco, Francesco Malandrino, Giuseppe Virone, Simone Morosi

application.scenario_description: Management and Orchestration (M&O) of Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial Networks (TN-NTN) for ISAC.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Proposal to use O-RAN (RIC) and 3GPP (NWDAF) architectures for collecting and analyzing sensing data in TN-NTN systems.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of unified Management and Orchestration (M&O) frameworks for ISAC in heterogeneous TN-NTN networks.

transmitter.notes: Discusses multi-band (mmWave, THz, Optical) but no specific Tx implementation.

receiver.notes: Focus on data collection and logical processing in RIC/NWDAF.

waveform.notes: Time/Frequency resource sharing of OFDM symbols (Fig 1).
